products.name: Kyocera DuraForce PRO 3
products.summary: Ultra-rugged 5G business phone (Verizon) with IP68, MIL-STD-810H and HazLoc certification, a 5.38-inch glove-friendly OLED, Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 and a removable battery.
products.description: DuraForce PRO 3 is Kyocera's ultra-rugged 5G smartphone sold through Verizon. It is IP68 waterproof, MIL-STD-810H drop tested to 5 ft on concrete and HazLoc certified, with a 5.38-inch FHD+ OLED that works with gloves and wet hands. It runs Android 15 (Android Enterprise Recommended) on a Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 with 6 GB RAM and 128 GB storage, has a 64 MP main plus 16 MP wide-angle and 2 MP macro camera and a 4,270 mAh removable battery with Qi wireless charging.
products.keywords: kyocera duraforce pro 3 rugged verizon hazloc business phone
